description: This Python script sets up and runs a speech synthesis bot using Pipecat framework components, supporting different transports and services, and defining an async main function to start the bot.

classes.name: Pipeline
classes.description: Represents a sequence of processing stages for the pipeline, including speech synthesis and transport output.

classes.name: PipelineTask
classes.description: Wraps a pipeline with configuration, manages task execution and idle timeout.

classes.name: PipelineRunner
classes.description: Manages execution of a pipeline, handles signals, and orchestrates asynchronous runs.

classes.name: CartesiaTTSService
classes.description: Provides Text-to-Speech conversion using Cartesia service, initialized with API key and voice ID.

classes.name: BaseTransport
classes.description: Abstract class for communication transports, supporting event handling and output functionality.

methods.name: run_bot(transport: BaseTransport, runner_args: RunnerArguments)
methods.description: Asynchronously initializes the speech synthesis pipeline with transport, and runs the bot behavior including event handling.

methods.name: bot(runner_args: RunnerArguments)
methods.description: Main entry point for the bot, creates transport and calls run_bot.
